query:
SELECT u.id as userId, u.name as userName, d.id as dentistId, d.name as dentistName 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN dentists d ON LOWER(u.name) = LOWER(d.name) AND u.clinicId = d.clinicId
WHERE u.clinicId = 60002 AND u.role = 'dentist';
